TABLE 5: Empirical Comparison of Edge Explainability Overhead (Journal Paper)
========================================================================================
| Method                                | Latency / frame | Throughput | Model Size | XAI Type       |
|---------------------------------------|-----------------|------------|------------|----------------|
| Isolation Forest alone (InCIS 2027)   |    1.424 ms    |    702.3 fps |    588.9 KB | None           |
| Isolation Forest + TreeSHAP (Baseline)|    8.403 ms    |    119.0 fps |    588.9 KB | Post-hoc Tree  |
| Autoencoder Float32 (Proposed)        |    0.018 ms    |  55363.5 fps |     68.6 KB | Single-Pass    |
| Autoencoder INT8 (Proposed Deploy)    |    0.056 ms    |  17933.5 fps |     28.8 KB | Single-Pass Q8 |
========================================================================================
Key Finding: Proposed Single-Pass INT8 Autoencoder provides per-packet local attribution
             150.7x faster than TreeSHAP, maintaining real-time edge line rate (> 17933 fps).
